topics.topic: AdmissionVerdict identity for repeated admission against an unchanged corpus
questions: When the same implementation is submitted again against an unchanged corpus, is the existing verdict reused, or is a new verdict created for the newly minted TrialExecutions?
When the same implementation is submitted again against the unchanged corpus, is the prior AdmissionVerdict returned, or is a new verdict record created for the new trial executions?

When the same implementation is submitted again against the same unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict reused, replaced, or is a distinct verdict created for the newly minted TrialExecutions?

judgement.why: This asks the same question as P2, and neither the relevant passages nor the change since closure altered it.

precedent.topic: AdmissionVerdict reuse versus recreation on identical resubmission
quotes: Submitting an implementation — new, or equal to an existing one — runs admission unless an AdmissionVerdict M08 for that implementation and the current corpus digest already exists, in which case that verdict is used.
precedent.why: The later rule says the existing verdict is reused, so no new admission TrialExecutions are created for an unchanged implementation-and-corpus pair.

topics.topic: ProofResult identity when external binding or manifest facts change
questions: What identifies a ProofResult when the same immutable flow version can have different results as referenced bindings move from proposed to accepted?
What distinguishes two ProofResults for the same immutable flow version when an external proof dependency, such as a binding's acceptance status, changes?

Is a ProofResult identified by the flow version alone, or by the flow version together with the binding and manifest facts observed when proof is computed, so that one version can have different results over time?

judgement.why: This asks the same question as P3, and neither the relevant passages nor the change since closure altered it.

precedent.topic: ProofResult identity across changing binding state
quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
precedent.why: The change did not touch M17 or make ProofResult identity newly consequential.

topics.topic: Accepting an already accepted binding when no service instance is selected
questions: If an accepted binding's service currently has no selected instance, does another accept request return that binding or refuse the request?

topics.topic: Authority for retrying a draft-write attempt that was not sent
questions: Under what authority is a `draft-write` retried after its attempt ended `not_sent`, given that its original authority was a flow activation rather than an approval?

topics.topic: Authorization and scope for inspecting implementation source
questions: Which product action may return implementation source, to which actors, and for which implementations?

topics.topic: Eligibility for capturing a failed execution into a TrialCase
questions: May a failed function execution be captured after its run ends in a status other than `failed`, and does eligibility differ between value-only inputs and inputs containing spooled files?

topics.topic: Run status when failures coexist with waiting branches
questions: When one branch has failed and all remaining unfinished branches are waiting, is the run still waiting or does it end as `failed`?

topics.topic: Run terminal status when work succeeds but guarded nodes or outputs are skipped
questions: When all executed work succeeds but one or more nodes or outputs are `skipped_by_guard`, does the run end `succeeded`, end under another existing status, or remain non-final?

topics.topic: Whether TrialCase expected outputs may cover only a subset of output ports
questions: When `expected_outputs` is present, must it contain every contract output port, or may an authored trial case assert only a subset of outputs?

topics.topic: Whether a run may be cancelled while an effect outcome is unknown
questions: May the owner cancel a run while an EffectAttempt is `unknown`, leaving that attempt permanently unresolved?

topics.topic: Whether installation identity changes with configuration
questions: Is an installation a stable entity whose configuration can change, or is each distinct configuration value a different installation?
